questions.question: Which tag marks a TAP checkout request?
questions.explanation: agent-payer-auth is for checkout and payment; agent-browser-auth is for browsing. web-bot-auth is the IETF draft's tag and Agent-pay-auth is Mastercard's.

questions.question: What are the minimum covered components of a TAP signature?
questions.explanation: TAP requires only @authority and @path; method, query and digest are not in the minimum.

questions.question: How far apart may created and expires be?
questions.explanation: TAP caps the window at 8 minutes. The Web Bot Auth draft recommends 24 hours or less.

questions.question: What does TAP call the nonce?
options: A one-time random value per request
A hash of the request body
A session identifier for the signatures
A counter of the agent's requests
questions.explanation: TAP calls the nonce a session identifier: several signatures in one header should share it, and each signed body object repeats it.

questions.question: Which key URL did the TAP specification name until October 2026?
options: The URL in the Signature-Agent header
questions.explanation: Until October 2026 the specification named Visa's JWKS at mcp.visa.com; the moved page names no URL, and Visa's own code uses that JWKS to encrypt tokens for its MCP server.

questions.question: What did that JWKS hold on 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-19?
options: No keys at all, an empty set
One EC P-256 key for ES256 signing
One RSA key from a Visa sandbox CA
questions.explanation: One 2048-bit RSA key with a certificate from a Visa sandbox issuing CA, and no Ed25519 key.

questions.question: Which object carries contextualData?
questions.explanation: The consumer recognition object agenticConsumer holds nonce, idToken, contextualData, kid, alg and signature.

questions.question: When does a payment container carry a browsingIOU?
options: When the merchant asked for payment with HTTP 402
On every checkout request the agent signs
For a key-entered guest checkout at the merchant
Only when the card is a Mastercard card
questions.explanation: browsingIOU is present when the merchant requested payment with a 402 response.

questions.question: Who authored the card method of Stripe MPP?
questions.explanation: draft-card-charge-00 is authored by Jacob Brans of Visa and says a client may include TAP headers.

questions.question: When did Visa announce TAP?
questions.explanation: Visa announced TAP on 2025-10-14, developed with Cloudflare. 2025-04-30 is VIC's unveiling.
